name: @codegen-x/ui-gates
description: Portable UI8Kit gates: (1) source rule: no raw HTML tag where a UI8Kit primitive exists, Box/Text tag only from the HTML5 allowlist, in tsx/jsx, svelte, vue, templ, twig, latte, jinja2; (2) rendered HTML: html-validate (HTML5, content model, no interactive in interactive) and axe-core in jsdom (ARIA, landmarks, labels).
